Notes to the Statement of Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Six Months ended September 30, 2026

1. The above unaudited financial results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on November 04, 2026 and November 05, 2026. These financial results have been prepared in accordance with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 (as amended)(Ind AS) prescribed under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 and other recognised accounting practices and policies to the extent applicable. The Statutory Auditors of the Company have conducted a limited review of these unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026, in accordance with Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended and expressed an unmodified review conclusion on these unaudited results.
2. During the quarter, the Company has incurred a loss due to a fire incident at its godown located at Warehouse No. 1S/1-A, Madurai Bye Pass Road, Tuticorin on 1 August 2026. The fire resulted in damage to inventories, and the estimated loss amounting to Rs. 26.78 crore has been recognised in the Statement of Profit and Loss as an Exceptional Item. The Company has lodged an insurance claim with the insurer in respect of the loss incurred. As the claim is under assessment and pending settlement as of the reporting date and insurance receivable will be recognised upon approval of claim by insurance company.
3. The Company has been allotted 56.12 acres of land at Virudhunagar, Tamil Nadu, under the PM MITRA Scheme for setting up a new textile manufacturing facility. During the quarter, Rs. 31.05 crore was paid for allotment of land, while execution of the 99-year lease deed is pending procedural completion by SIPCOT. The project is expected to benefit from integrated infrastructure, including CETP facilities, and government incentives. The proposed facility is expected to support the Company's future capacity expansion and long-term growth strategy.
4. The shareholders of the Company approved the GHCL Textiles ESOS Scheme 2026 (“Scheme”), providing for the grant of up to 45,00,000 stock options, by special resolution passed through postal ballot on September 10, 2026. On November 4, 2026, the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, acting as the Compensation Committee under the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021, granted 3,00,000 stock options to the Chief Executive Officer under the Scheme. Each option is exercisable into one equity share of face value Rs. 2at Rs. 120.56 per share, being the closing market price on National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) with the highest trading volume on November 3, 2026, without any discount. The options vest in two equal tranches of 1,50,000 options each, not earlier than one year from the grant date, subject to achievement of KPI's as determined by Nomination and Remuneration Committee. Vested options are exercisable within five years from the date of vesting. The grant is a non-adjusting event after the reporting period and has no effect on the results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The options will be accounted for under Ind AS 102, Share based Payment, at their fair value on the grant date, and the cost will be recognised as employee benefits expense over the vesting period.
5. The figures of the quarter and six month ended September 30, 2025 and for the year ended March 31, 2026 were subjected to limited review/ audit by the predecessor auditor.
6. The Company is engaged in the business of "Textiles" activity and hence has only one reportable operating segment as per Ind AS 108-Operating Segment.
7. In line with the requirements of Regulation 47(2) of the Listing Regulations, 2015, the results are available on the website of BSE Limited (URL: www.bseindia.com), the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (URL: www.nseindia.com) and on the Company’s website (URL: https://ghcltextiles.co.in/investors/financial-reports)
